alphaVerified: All PNG files are RGBA with alpha extrema 0 and 255 (Pillow read-only inspection).
referenceUse: Existing project originals visually inspected for style; no image inputs passed to these new generation calls.
processing: Original generated PNG files copied byte-for-byte; no pixel editing or recompression. Runtime crop rectangles and two clipping polygons separate adjacent bat/hound fur, and sprites.js positions separate parts on animated skeletons.
runtimeFallback: Each sheet independently falls back to the corresponding Canvas drawing until its Image.onload; no new stats, collision, save or AI fields.

assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original transparent 2D skeletal-animation game sprite atlas for a Chinese mythology action game. Create ONE square texture sheet of SIX completely separate painted parts in a strict TWO-column by THREE-row grid. Every cell contains exactly one large isolated part, centered with generous transparent gutters so parts never touch; no labels, no panel borders, no background, no cast shadows. All pieces share a right-facing three-quarter side view and the same lighting from upper left. Painterly cel-shaded Q-version Chinese fantasy game art matching a richly painted little Monkey King: crisp dark brown outlines, rounded solid forms, beautiful layered brushwork, warm gold edge lights, readable material variation and expressive eyes, NOT flat vector art, NOT realistic grotesque anatomy. Top row LEFT: shrimp soldier head only, coral-red chitin helmet with a long swept-back paired antenna, pointed shrimp rostrum nose, alert amber eyes, small cheek plates, recognizably shrimp-like rather than a plain human. Top row RIGHT: separate shrimp soldier chest-to-waist armor only, rounded coral-red segmented shell cuirass with jade-teal and antique gold trim, short overlapping waist plates; hollow neck and shoulder openings, no head, arms, hands, legs, tail or weapons. Middle row LEFT: fire demon head only, compact mischievous ochre-red face with broad cheekbones, bright amber eyes, thick eyebrows, flowing flame-shaped red/orange hair with pale gold cores, expressive stern face. Middle row RIGHT: separate fire demon chest-to-waist armor only, charcoal plum lamellar cuirass with glowing ember flame crest and warm bronze edging, short burnt-red waist cloth; hollow neck and shoulder openings, no head, arms, hands, legs or weapon. Bottom row LEFT: celestial royal guard head only, stern young man with expressive brown eyes and a small moustache, burgundy helmet with restrained gold filigree and one sweeping dark-red plume. Bottom row RIGHT: separate royal guard chest-to-waist armor only, rich burgundy and antique gold Chinese lamellar armor with a cloud medallion and short plated skirt; hollow neck and shoulder openings, no head, arms, hands, legs, cape or weapon. Keep all six pieces anatomically compatible with a stout 2.8-head-tall chibi skeleton. Each head fills nearly its cell without clipping the antennae or plume. Each torso is short and broad, approximately as wide as the head. Genuine clean alpha transparency everywhere outside each object. No complete assembled character, no other items, no text, no watermark.
